content_zh:
第0001章午夜餐馆的刀光城中村的霓虹总带着股油烟味。
巴刀鱼用油腻的抹布擦着缺了角的餐桌，抬头瞥了眼墙上挂钟——凌晨一点十七分。玻璃门外，暴雨把街道浇成模糊的光斑，偶尔有晚归的醉汉踩着积水路过，骂骂咧咧的声音被雨声吞得只剩半截。
“刀哥，要不打烊吧？这鬼天气哪还会有客人。”后厨传来清脆的女声，穿洗得发白工装的少女探出头，发梢还沾着面粉。她叫娃娃鱼，十七岁，半年前被巴刀鱼捡回餐馆，名义上是帮工，实则更像个需要照顾的小妹。
巴刀鱼刚要应声，玻璃门突然被一股蛮力撞开，雨水裹挟着冷风灌进来，吹得墙上的菜单哗啦啦响。三个浑身湿透的男人闯了进来，为首的壮汉满脸横肉，左眼一道疤痕从眉骨延伸到下颌，进门就把沾血的棒球棍往吧台上一砸：“老板，有什么吃的？赶紧上！”
巴刀鱼皱眉盯着那根棒球棍上的暗红痕迹，指尖不自觉攥紧了抹布：“只剩番茄炒蛋、酸辣土豆丝，还有最后一份酸菜鱼。”
“全上！再加三瓶冰啤酒！”疤痕男一屁股坐下，另外两个小弟也跟着落座，目光在狭小的餐馆里扫来扫去，眼神里透着股戾气。娃娃鱼吓得缩了缩脖子，快步钻进后厨。
巴刀鱼没动，盯着疤痕男的手腕——那里隐约浮出一层青黑色纹路，像某种诡异的纹身，却在灯光下微微蠕动。他想起前几天巷口老张说的话，最近城中村总有人半夜斗殴，下手狠得不像普通人，据说有人能一拳打碎水泥墙。
“磨蹭什么？想挨揍？”一个小弟拍着桌子站起来，露出腰间别着的弹簧刀。
巴刀鱼收回目光，转身走向后厨。狭小的后厨里，娃娃鱼正哆嗦着切土豆，见他进来，小声问：“刀哥，他们看起来好凶……”
“别怕，炒你的菜。”巴刀鱼揉了揉她的头，拿起挂在墙上的菜刀。这把刀跟着他三年，刀刃磨得发亮，刀柄被掌心的汗浸得发黑。他掂了掂刀，目光落在案板上的草鱼上——这是今天最后一条鱼，鳞片泛着不正常的暗青色，是下午从菜市场角落里一个独眼老头那买的，当时老头说这鱼“有点不一样”，给的价格比市场价低一半。
菜刀落下的瞬间，巴刀鱼突然觉得指尖一热，一股奇怪的暖流顺着手臂涌向刀柄。刀刃划过鱼鳞，竟发出轻微的嗡鸣，原本暗青色的鳞片在刀光下闪过一丝金芒，随即消散。他愣了愣，以为是错觉，继续处理鱼身，剖开鱼腹时，一股浓郁的鲜香扑面而来，比以往任何一次处理鲜鱼都要醇厚。
“刀哥，番茄炒蛋好了！”娃娃鱼把盘子递过来，脸上还带着怯意。
巴刀鱼端着菜走出后厨时，前厅的气氛更紧张了。疤痕男正用棒球棍戳着地板，青黑色纹路在他手臂上蔓延得更快了，像有生命的藤蔓。“妈的，这么慢！”他抬头瞪向巴刀鱼，眼睛里竟泛起一丝诡异的绿光。
就在这时，疤痕男突然捂住肚子，闷哼一声，额头上冒出冷汗。他身边的小弟见状，立刻掏出弹簧刀：“你他妈在菜里放了什么？”
“放心，没毒。”巴刀鱼把菜放在桌上，目光扫过疤痕男手臂上的纹路，“倒是你们，最近是不是总觉得浑身发热，晚上睡不好？”
疤痕男脸色一变：“你怎么知道？”
巴刀鱼没回答，转身回后厨端酸菜鱼。刚掀开锅盖，一股白气蒸腾而上，锅里的酸菜和鱼肉竟然在翻滚的汤汁中微微发光，暖流再次从指尖涌来，这次更强烈了，顺着手臂蔓延到心口，让他浑身都觉得暖洋洋的。他忽然明白，这鱼真的“不一样”，而自己身上好像也发生了某种变化。
端着酸菜鱼走出后厨时，疤痕男已经疼得蜷缩在椅子上，手臂上的青黑色纹路剧烈蠕动着，像是在挣扎。巴刀鱼把酸菜鱼放在他面前，汤汁的鲜香瞬间弥漫整个前厅，那两个小弟下意识地咽了咽口水。
“尝尝这个。”巴刀鱼指了指酸菜鱼。
疤痕男犹豫了一下，被疼痛逼得没办法，拿起筷子夹了一块鱼肉塞进嘴里。鱼肉入口即化，一股清凉的暖流顺着喉咙滑进肚子，原本灼烧般的疼痛感竟然瞬间减轻了大半。他眼睛一亮，不顾烫嘴，大口吃了起来，手臂上的青黑色纹路以肉眼可见的速度消退着。

“这……这是什么鱼？”疤痕男一边吃一边问，语气里的戾气少了大半。
“普通草鱼。”巴刀鱼靠在吧台边，把玩着手里的菜刀，“不过你们身上的东西，不是普通饭菜能解决的。”
就在这时，玻璃门再次被推开，这次走进来的是个穿着红色皮衣的女人，长发披肩，脸上带着一道浅浅的疤痕，手里提着一个不锈钢饭盒。她扫视了一眼前厅，目光最终落在疤痕男身上，嘴角勾起一抹冷笑：“丧彪，没想到你也会有求人的时候。”
疤痕男看到女人，脸色瞬间变得惨白，挣扎着想要站起来，却被女人一脚踩在椅子上：“别动，你身上的‘食煞’快发作了，再动小心爆体而亡。”
巴刀鱼皱眉看着女人，她身上也有一股奇怪的气息，和疤痕男身上的青黑色纹路有些相似，却更凝练，带着一股辛辣的压迫感。
女人转头看向巴刀鱼，眼神锐利如刀：“你就是这家餐馆的老板？刚才的酸菜鱼是你做的？”
“怎么？”巴刀鱼握紧了菜刀，指尖的暖流再次涌动，这次他清晰地感觉到，菜刀上似乎附着了一层微弱的力量。
“有点意思。”女人笑了笑，从饭盒里拿出一个油纸包，放在吧台上，“我叫酸菜汤，也是个厨师。听说你这里有能治‘食煞’的菜，特来讨教一下。”
油纸包打开的瞬间，一股浓郁的酸辣味扑面而来，比巴刀鱼做的酸菜鱼更烈，带着一股凌厉的气息，让后厨的娃娃鱼忍不住打了个喷嚏。巴刀鱼盯着油纸包里的菜——那是一盘酸辣土豆丝，土豆丝切得细如发丝，色泽金黄，上面点缀着红色的辣椒，明明是普通的家常菜，却透着一股不寻常的气势。
疤痕男看着酸菜汤，眼神里充满恐惧：“酸姐，我错了，以后再也不敢抢你的生意了……”
“现在知道错了？晚了。”酸菜汤一脚踹开椅子，疤痕男摔在地上，疼得龇牙咧嘴，手臂上的青黑色纹路又开始蔓延。她转头看向巴刀鱼，语气带着挑衅：“敢不敢跟我比一场？谁赢了，谁就接手这片区的‘玄厨生意’。”
巴刀鱼愣了愣，“玄厨”？这是他第一次听到这个词。但他看着地上痛苦挣扎的疤痕男，又看了看后厨里瑟瑟发抖的娃娃鱼，握紧了手里的菜刀。刚才烹饪时的暖流，酸菜鱼带来的奇异效果，还有眼前这个叫酸菜汤的女人身上的气息，都在告诉他，平静的生活已经结束了。
暴雨还在下，午夜的餐馆里，刀光与菜香交织。巴刀鱼看着酸菜汤眼中的战意，突然笑了：“比就比，输的人，以后不准在这片区闹事。”
酸菜汤挑眉：“爽快！就比做酸菜鱼，食材用你这里的，谁做的能彻底驱散丧彪身上的‘食煞’，谁就赢。”
巴刀鱼转身走向后厨，路过娃娃鱼身边时，低声说：“别害怕，看哥露一手。”
他拿起案板上的菜刀，再次握住刀柄的瞬间，暖流汹涌而至，这次他清晰地感觉到，刀刃上仿佛覆盖了一层金色的微光。案板上的草鱼虽然已经处理干净，却依然在微微跳动，像是有生命一般。
酸菜汤跟着走进后厨，看着巴刀鱼手里的菜刀，眼神微微一凝：“你这刀，有点门道。”
巴刀鱼没说话，专注地看着锅里的汤汁。当酸菜下锅的瞬间，他手腕翻动，菜刀在锅里快速搅拌，金色的微光随着刀刃的动作闪烁，锅里的汤汁竟然开始沸腾起来，冒着金色的气泡。一旁的酸菜汤瞳孔骤缩，她能感觉到，巴刀鱼的动作里蕴含着某种特殊的韵律，正在激发食材里的奇异力量。
前厅里，疤痕男的惨叫声越来越小，他能感觉到，两股截然不同的气息从后厨传来，一股清凉醇厚，一股凌厉辛辣，都在牵引着他身上的“食煞”。而在餐馆门外的暴雨中，一个戴着斗笠的老头正站在暗处，看着后厨里的刀光，嘴角勾起一抹神秘的笑容，手里把玩着一块姜黄色的令牌，令牌上刻着一个古老的“厨”字。
巴刀鱼不知道，这场午夜的厨艺比拼，只是他踏入玄厨世界的开始。在这座钢筋水泥的都市里，隐藏着无数玄异的秘密，而他手中的菜刀，将成为劈开黑暗的第一道光芒。
content_en:
Chapter 0001 The Daoguang of Midnight Restaurant The neon lights in the urban village always smell of oily smoke.
Ba Yu wiped the missing corner of the dining table with a greasy rag, and glanced up at the clock on the wall - one seventeen in the morning. Outside the glass door, the heavy rain turned the street into a blur of light. Occasionally, drunkards returning home late passed by in the puddles, and their curses were only half swallowed by the sound of rain.
"Brother Dao, why don't we close? How can we have customers in this damn weather?" A clear female voice came from the kitchen, and a girl in work clothes that had been washed white stuck her head out, with the ends of her hair still stained with flour. Her name is Baby Fish, and she is seventeen years old. She was picked up by Batfish and brought back to the restaurant half a year ago. She is a helper in name, but in reality she is more like a little girl who needs to be taken care of.
Just as Ba Yu was about to respond, the glass door was suddenly knocked open by a violent force, and the rain and cold wind rushed in, making the menu on the wall rattle. Three soaked men broke in. The leading man had a fleshy face and a scar on his left eye extending from his brow bone to his jaw. As soon as he entered the door, he smashed a bloody baseball bat on the bar: "Boss, what's there to eat? Hurry up!"
Ba Yu frowned and stared at the dark red marks on the baseball bat, and unconsciously clenched the rag with his fingertips: "Only the tomato scrambled eggs, spicy and sour potato shreds, and the last pickled fish are left."
"All in! And three more bottles of cold beer!" The scarred man sat down, and the other two boys followed suit. His eyes swept around the small restaurant, with a look of violence in his eyes. The giant salamander shrank its neck in fright and quickly got into the kitchen.
The bat fish did not move, staring at the scarred man's wrist - there was a layer of blue-black lines faintly emerging there, like some kind of weird tattoo, but it squirmed slightly under the light. He remembered what Lao Zhang said in the alley a few days ago. Recently, there are always people fighting in the middle of the night in villages in the city. Their attacks are not like ordinary people. It is said that some people can break concrete walls with one punch.
"Why are you dawdling? Do you want to be beaten?" A boy stood up and patted the table, revealing the switchblade at his waist.
The fish withdrew its gaze and turned towards the kitchen. In the small back kitchen, Salamander was shivering and chopping potatoes. Seeing him come in, she asked in a low voice: "Brother Dao, they look so fierce..."
"Don't be afraid, let's fry your food." Ba Yuyu rubbed her head and picked up the kitchen knife hanging on the wall. This knife has been with him for three years. The blade has been sharpened until it shines, and the handle is blackened by the sweat from his palm. He weighed the knife and his eyes fell on the grass carp on the chopping board - this was the last fish of the day, with abnormal dark blue scales. He bought it from a one-eyed old man in the corner of the market in the afternoon. At that time, the old man said that the fish was "a little different" and the price he gave it was half the market price.
The moment the kitchen knife fell, Basioyu suddenly felt his fingertips heat up, and a strange warmth flowed down his arm to the handle of the knife. The blade of the knife cut across the fish scales, making a slight buzzing sound. The originally dark blue scales flashed a golden light under the light of the knife, and then dissipated. He was stunned for a moment, thinking it was an illusion, and continued to handle the fish body. When he cut open the belly of the fish, a rich and fresh fragrance hit his face, which was more mellow than any time he had handled fresh fish before.
"Brother Dao, the tomato scrambled eggs are ready!" Baby Fish handed over the plate with a timid look on his face.
When Ba Yu walked out of the back kitchen carrying the dishes, the atmosphere in the front room became even more tense. The scarred man was poking the floor with a baseball bat, and the blue-black lines spread faster on his arms, like living vines. "Damn, so slow!" He raised his head and glared at the fish, with a strange green light in his eyes.
At this moment, the scarred man suddenly covered his stomach, groaned, and cold sweat broke out on his forehead. The boy next to him saw this and immediately took out a switchblade: "What the hell did you put in the dish?"
"Don't worry, it's not poisonous." The fish put the dishes on the table and glanced at the lines on the scarred man's arms. "But you guys, have you been feeling hot all over your body recently and have trouble sleeping at night?"
The scarred man's expression changed: "How do you know?"
The fish didn't answer and turned back to the kitchen.Serve pickled fish. As soon as he opened the lid of the pot, a burst of white steam steamed up. The pickled vegetables and fish in the pot actually shone slightly in the boiling soup. Warmth flowed from his fingertips again, this time stronger, spreading along his arms to his heart, making his whole body feel warm. He suddenly understood that this fish was really "different", and something seemed to have changed in him.
When he walked out of the kitchen with the pickled fish, the scarred man was already curled up on the chair in pain, and the blue and black lines on his arms were squirming violently, as if he was struggling. Ba Yu put the pickled fish in front of him, and the delicious aroma of the soup instantly filled the entire front hall, and the two boys swallowed subconsciously.
"Try this." The fish pointed to the pickled fish.
The scarred man hesitated for a moment, and was forced to do nothing by the pain. He picked up a piece of fish with chopsticks and stuffed it into his mouth. The fish melted in your mouth, and a cool warm current slid down your throat and into your stomach. The original burning pain was relieved by half in an instant. His eyes lit up, and he ate without caring about burning his mouth. The blue and black lines on his arms faded at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"What...what kind of fish is this?" The scarred man asked while eating, with most of the anger in his tone lessened.
"Ordinary grass carp." Basio fish leaned against the bar, playing with the kitchen knife in his hand, "But what you have on you cannot be solved by ordinary meals."
At this moment, the glass door was pushed open again, and this time a woman wearing a red leather jacket walked in, with long hair shawl-length, a shallow scar on her face, and a stainless steel lunch box in her hand. She glanced around the front hall, and finally her eyes fell on the scarred man, with a sneer on her lips: "Sangbiao, I didn't expect that you would also ask for help."
When the scarred man saw the woman, his face turned pale instantly. He struggled to stand up, but the woman stepped on the chair: "Don't move, the 'eating evil' in your body is about to attack. If you move again, be careful and you will explode and die."
The bat fish frowned and looked at the woman. She also had a strange aura on her body, which was somewhat similar to the blue and black lines on the scarred man's body, but more condensed, with a pungent sense of oppression.
The woman turned to look at the fish with sharp eyes: "Are you the owner of this restaurant? Did you make the pickled fish just now?"
"What?" Basioyu clenched the kitchen knife, and the warmth in his fingertips surged again. This time he clearly felt that there seemed to be a weak layer of power attached to the kitchen knife.
"It's interesting." The woman smiled, took out an oil paper bag from the lunch box, and put it on the bar. "My name is pickled cabbage soup, and I am also a chef. I heard that you have a dish that can cure 'eating evil', so I came here to ask for advice."
The moment the oil paper bag was opened, a strong sour and spicy smell hit the face. It was stronger than the pickled fish made from squid, and it had a sharp smell that made the giant salamander in the kitchen couldn't help but sneeze. Ba Yu stared at the dish in the oil paper bag - it was a plate of hot and sour potato shreds. The potatoes were cut as thin as hair, golden in color, and dotted with red peppers. It was obviously an ordinary home-cooked dish, but it exuded an unusual aura.
The scarred man looked at the pickled cabbage soup with fear in his eyes: "Sister Suan, I was wrong. I will never dare to steal your business again..."
"Do you know it's wrong now? It's too late." Pickled cabbage soup kicked the chair away, and the scarred man fell to the ground, grinning in pain, and the blue and black lines on his arms began to spread again. She turned to look at Ba Yu, and her tone was provocative: "Do you dare to compete with me? Whoever wins will take over the 'Xuan Chef Business' in this area."
Badaoyu was stunned, "Xuanchu"? This was the first time he heard the word. But he looked at the scarred man struggling in pain on the ground, and then at the shivering salamander in the kitchen, and tightened his grip on the kitchen knife in his hand. The warmth from the cooking just now, the strange effect brought by the pickled fish, and the smell of the woman named Pickled Soup in front of him all told him that his peaceful life had ended.it's over.
The heavy rain was still falling, and in the restaurant at midnight, the light of knives and the aroma of vegetables were intertwined. Seeing the fighting spirit in the pickled cabbage soup's eyes, Ba Yuyu suddenly smiled: "Let's compete. The loser will not be allowed to cause trouble in this area in the future."
The pickled cabbage soup raised his eyebrows: "Refreshing! It's like making pickled cabbage fish. The ingredients are from your place. Whoever makes it can completely drive away the 'eating evil' in Sang Biao, will win."
The baby fish turned around and walked towards the kitchen. When he passed by the baby fish, he whispered: "Don't be afraid, let's see what I can do."
He picked up the kitchen knife on the chopping board and held the handle again. Warmth surged over him. This time, he clearly felt that the blade seemed to be covered with a golden shimmer. Although the grass carp on the chopping board has been cleaned, it is still beating slightly, as if it is alive.
Pickled cabbage soup followed him into the kitchen. He looked at the kitchen knife in Ba Yu's hand and his eyes narrowed slightly: "You have some skills with this knife."
The fish didn't say anything and looked at the soup in the pot intently. When the sauerkraut was put into the pot, he flipped his wrist and stirred the kitchen knife quickly in the pot. The golden light flickered with the movement of the blade, and the soup in the pot began to boil with golden bubbles. The pupils of the pickled cabbage soup on the side suddenly shrank, and she could feel that there was a special rhythm in the movements of the fish, which was stimulating the strange power in the ingredients.
In the front hall, the scarred man's screams became smaller and smaller. He could feel that two completely different breaths came from the back kitchen, one was cool and mellow, and the other was sharp and spicy, both pulling at the "eating evil" in him. In the heavy rain outside the restaurant, an old man wearing a bamboo hat was standing in the dark, looking at the light of the knife in the back kitchen, with a mysterious smile on his lips, and playing with a ginger token in his hand, with an ancient word "kitchen" engraved on it.
Little did Basioyu know that this midnight cooking competition was just the beginning of his entry into the world of mysterious chefs. In this reinforced concrete city, there are countless mysterious secrets hidden, and the kitchen knife in his hand will become the first light to break through the darkness.
